reviews.text:
Owner (Jae) & entire staff are all so great.  Grooming my 2 Aussies is also great.  They car all 7 of the Nulo Dog Foods & Supplements that I use!  Just a wonderful experience!!
Please keep up the amazing work!!

Paws on Central made a beautiful cake for our Puppiversary celebration yesterday! I had a little trouble with other local vendors accommodating the custom writing we requested, but it was no problem at all here. They even had glitter sprinkles! All the pups had a blast and the cake and cupcakes really made the day extra special.

Went for a bath and brush for a noon appointment for a small 11 lb dog and at 2pm they still were not finished. I took my dog anyway because I couldn’t wait any longer and paid of course. I will definitely not be back.

Paws on Central did an absolutely amazing job Jaydn (jay was amazing too !) I can’t thank her enough my baby looks amazing and he wasn’t traumatized. Truly, a great groomer and doggy store amazing vibes and great people!

This was the first time we have used Paws on Central for dog grooming. We were extremely happy with the job they did with our dog Blue. The appointment scheduling and check-in process were both easy and convenient. They were friendly and communicative throughout the entire process and listened to our requests regarding the type of cut we wanted for him. We were impressed from beginning to end and will definitely be using them for all of his future groomings. I highly recommend giving them a try as you will be happy you did!
Small, intimate shop. Relaxing atmosphere. Jadyn did an amazing job on our pup. It was her first grooming possibly ever. She really liked it there & looks amazing.
So happy we found this place! Ashley and Jadyn took amazing care of our dogs, and we’ll definitely be coming back on a recurring basis.

Love this place! I have taken my little girl here several times, always booked online, I have never requested a groomer because they all are super great. Great customer service and products for the fur baby.
Checked out Paws on Central for the first time, and they did an amazing grooming job on my dog Dash! Nice staff, cute & clean on the inside. We'll be back!
They did amazing work on my foster kitty Marlo and were so kind and considerate 🩷and the place is nicely decorated for animals. …
Awesome Shop! Great selection of healthy food treats and toys
10/10 would recommend! The team was excellent, and my dog looks great!

Brought our two golden retrievers in to be groomed. Ciara did a great job on both of them. It’s a smaller place so you can have the same groomer for each appointment. This is my new goto for grooming.

LOVE THIS LICAL GEM!! They were so nice to my little Shasta. She is a little princess with a flair for the drama scream. Her nails are perfect and she loves loves their homemade freeze dried beef liver snacks! A big bag is a great deal with a 3$ off coupon from the trial bag he gave us it was $9.99 for her snacks and 10 bucks ( Feb 1st timer special) for nail Dremeling and I tipped her $5.
Best dollars I've spent in more than a minute cause my Chihuahua has great claws and a happy beef liver snack belly!
Go here do it...get yer angel a pawticure. Get em some snacks. Support your local business! They are paws and tails above the rest! Before is her paws crossed , after is a single paw!
Highly recommend!

Ana, 

Thank you so much for the 5-star rating! We’re thrilled to hear you had a great experience with us. Providing top-notch service is what we strive for every day, and knowing we hit the mark for you truly makes our day. See you again soon!

The Paws Team

Amazing salon, so beautiful and clean, the people there truly love all dogs and cats, I especially love the amazing pick up and drop off service they have.  I work from home so its so convenient to have them pick up my pup, groom him, then bring him home to me and he gets a special tag that I can track his trip to and from the groomer.  The next best thing is they sell all kinds of amazing fresh and organic dog foods, and again with the drop off and pick up service, when I drop off Bingo, they can add food to my bill, and bring it when they drop Bingo off.  So, amazing and such a wonderful experience, I highly recommend this salon.

Their groomers go above and beyond to provide a fabulous experience for your fur baby!

PS-They sell cakes and pupcakes, frozen treats and goodies for your pups birthday or special occasion or just to treat your fur baby!

They took great care of my baby on her 4th Birthday. They sent her home with a bow, a bandana, and a plethora of treats. Great customer service, and they gave her a full service grooming at a great price since they are new to the neighborhood. Will 100% be coming back to spoil my pup again😄

We love this place and so do our fur babies. The staff is all wonderful and treat our babies with kindness and care. We highly recommend them. Shout out to Scott for the amazing organic treats. Do your doggy a favor and book an appointment
These are wonderful folks who clearly love what they do. Who takes a progress pic? Combine that spa treatment with reasonable prices and cute boutique, and it’s clear. This place is a gem.

Absolutely obsessed with how adorable my pomsky’s groom turned out. They did such an incredible job. His coat is perfectly shaped, super soft, and still looks balanced, sharp, and natural. You can tell they really understand double-coated dogs and know how to groom them properly.

He came back home with a sassy pep in his step, which says everything about how well he was treated.

If you have a pom, pom mix, or any fluffy breed, this is 100% the place to go. The pick up and drop off service is also very convenient!

Visiting from NY, and desperately needed my dog groomed. They did the BEST job ever! Everyone was so kind and gentle. And for the first time in over two years, I go the exact cut I wanted for my dog! My dog hates getting groomed, but when he was ready to go, he actually wanted to stay and hang out. So I give them a PERFECT rating and so does my dog❣️ Bonus: they also helped me with some food choices for my super finicky dog. LOVE THEM!

Thank you so much for the 5-star Review - we look forward to seeing you and your pups real soon. 

The Paws Team

Susan and her staff are not only amazing at what they do, they are also amazing human beings. And make you and your dog feel welcome from the getgo. I brought in my chow chow for a full shampoo, deshed & trim, he also had some mats and a compressed coat from not being brushed for a few months. Mark took amazing care of my boy and had him back to me in 3 hours. I have nothing but good things to say about this place. Bring your dog here if you don't want to worry about your fur babies being in good, gentle hands. Thanks Paws On Central!!!! We will be back soon!
They really helped me out when I was in a bind!
